text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Frames 15.0 to 15.8 s. The overhead car yaws and slides left across the creek, tilted about 30 degrees, with foam at its trailing end and curved wake lines. By 15.8 s it is partly cropped at the left frame edge. Caption unchanged.
